description: Web players (Letterbox / Pillarbox): parses the HTML5 media error code and network/DRM/IL signals out of data.log, and compares success rates across browsers, OS and player versions.

panels.description: 1 - errors/starts on the Web platform, excluding business errors (blocked), DRM_NOT_SUPPORTED and CONNECTION_ERROR.
panels.title: Success rate (Web)

panels.description: Both web players side by side (ignores the Player filter). Parallel dips = shared cause (stream/CDN/IL); a dip in only one = that player.
panels.title: Success rate over time — Letterbox vs Pillarbox

panels.description: Sessions, real errors, and blocked plays (business errors: geoblock, start date, age rating…).
panels.title: Totals

panels.description: HTML5 MediaError parsed from the '(CODE:N MEDIA_ERR_…)' line in data.log — for Letterbox this is the only place the real code appears (data.name is 'undefined: 19'). Includes DRM_NOT_SUPPORTED / CONNECTION_ERROR. A log with several errors counts in each matching bucket.
panels.title: Media error code over time (parsed from data.log)

panels.description: Share of each media error code among non-blocked errors.
panels.title: Media error share

panels.description: data.error_type / sessions per bucket (includes the error types excluded from success rate, for context).
panels.title: Error rate by error type

panels.description: Phrases in the player log that point to the network, CDN, Integration Layer or DRM licence rather than the player itself. HTTP status is only logged for IL requests (httpStatusCode) and some playlist failures; segment 5xx are not reported by the web players.

filters.label: HLS segment/request error
filters.query: data.log:"request errored" OR data.log:"segment request error"

panels.title: Network / server signals in data.log

panels.description: Top 8 browsers (ignores the Browser filter). A browser far below the others points to browser/DRM support, not the stream.
panels.title: Success rate by browser

panels.description: Which browsers produce which media error codes.
panels.title: Media error code by browser

panels.description: Per browser and OS, with media error counts parsed from data.log.
panels.title: Browser / OS breakdown

panels.description: Top 10 Letterbox web versions. If all versions dip together, the drop is not version-specific.
panels.title: Letterbox (Web) success rate by version

panels.description: Top 10 Pillarbox web versions. If all versions dip together, the drop is not version-specific.
panels.title: Pillarbox (Web) success rate by version

panels.description: Per player and version, with media error counts parsed from data.log.
panels.title: Web player versions

panels.description: Not counted as failures. Shown so blocked plays (geoblock, start/end date, age rating, VPN) are not mistaken for player errors.
panels.title: Blocked plays by reason (business errors)

panels.title: Error events (parsed)
